summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K reporting progress under the first tranche of its share buyback program approved July 29, 2026, with HSBC Continental Europe as manager. Between August 10-14, 2026, purchases totaled €246,999,722.12, approximately 24.70% of the tranche's maximum cash amount. The filing provides no per-share price, premium, or close date. As an issuer repurchasing its own shares, this is a capital return special situation. Watch for further tranche updates and completion of the program's maximum authorized amount.
